_comment: Metalstorm native JS UI manifest (PLAN-native-ui.md §3 — the game JS-widget API is Stage 7A-4, not built yet). Widgets receive a ui-store read API, a DOM mount inside #ui-root, and the validated command/directive submission API. This manifest is the proposed shape; the loader contract is owned by PLAN-native-ui.md.

widgets._builtin_note: Mounted from the client bundle (client/src/native-widgets/command-composer.js) via BUILTIN_WIDGETS, not fetched from this dir — it depends on bundled compile-table + named-entity-index modules. The game-dir command-composer.js is a stub kept for reference.
